; config/assets.txt: machine-readable per-asset manifest for DREAM.sfc, generated by
; tools/gen_assets.py from config/regions.txt and the ROM's own code-driven structures
; (the sprite frame table at 0x040000, the animation script index at 0x041858, the song
; table at 0x0210B9, and the BRR sample chain at 0x023095-0x035163). Regenerate with:
;
;   python3 tools/gen_assets.py generate baserom/DREAM.sfc config/regions.txt config/assets.txt
;
; Format: one line per asset, fields separated by whitespace, comment after ';':
;
;   <start6hex> <end6hex> <kind> <path>    ; free-text note
;
; start/end are 6 hex digit file offsets (CPU $C0:0000 + offset, HiROM), end exclusive.
; Assets are sorted by start, contiguous and non-overlapping over the whole 2 MiB image
; (000000-200000): every byte belongs to exactly one asset. path is the file under data/
; that tools/extract.py writes the asset to (gitignored, like the half-bank files); it is
; never committed. kind is one of: anim_script, anim_table, brr, code, entity_table, filler, hdma, map, metatiles, palette, sfx_bank, song, spc_table, sprite_frame, sprite_frame_alt, sprite_table, stale, tilemap, tileset_2bpp, tileset_4bpp, tileset_8bpp, unknown.
;
; See docs/data_formats.md "Asset manifest" section for the derivation of each kind.

000000 003000 stale        data/stale/stale_code.bin        ; stale build: 65816 code, older assembly of the same program (modules reordered); reset prologue 18 FB 78 C2 30
003000 004b00 stale        data/stale/stale_anim_table.bin  ; stale build: older copy of the animation-script table (8-byte records)
004b00 007ac8 stale        data/stale/stale_tiles.bin       ; stale build: 4bpp tiles
007ac8 007ec0 stale        data/stale/stale_palette.bin     ; stale build: palette block, 508 x 15-bit BGR words
007ec0 008000 stale        data/stale/stale_tail.bin        ; stale build: tail, mostly FF
008000 00c00d code         data/misc/main_program.bin       ; 65816 main program (game_mode dispatch, DMA/HDMA setup, entity/physics code); embedded data tables (84A2 HDMA, 84B5 wave, 8791-8A5A HDMA/CGRAM misc, A443 zero word, A6D3/A6D7 OAM masks, B208-B24C streaming descriptors + index, B26C-B2F6 spawn list, B2FA-B4A4 per-state Y table, B4A4-B4B4 mode offsets, B4B4-B66A entity init records, B66A/B6DC/B7AE state tables) counted as code per progress-tool convention
00c00d 00c054 hdma         data/hdma/hdma_inidisp_table.bin ; HDMA table, indirect mode $48, for INIDISP: 3-byte entries {lines, ptr16 -> $7F:0Fxx brightness bytes}
00c054 00ffd4 filler       data/filler/filler_0637.bin      ; filler: repeated 06 37 00 37 run (tilemap word $306/$300 pal 5 pri 1); overwrites internal header area
00ffd4 00ffe4 filler       data/filler/header_remnants.bin  ; internal header remnants (map mode/ROM type/size bytes partly overwritten)
00ffe4 010000 filler       data/filler/cpu_vectors.bin      ; CPU vectors; RARE ASCII in unused vector slots
010000 010100 tilemap      data/maps/tilemap_strip1.bin     ; 32x4 tilemap, tile idx 44.. increasing, picture strip, palette 7 pri 1
010100 012800 tileset_4bpp data/gfx/tiles_strip1.bin        ; 4bpp tiles for the picture strip above (unreferenced)
012800 012900 tilemap      data/maps/tilemap_strip2.bin     ; 32x4 tilemap, tile idx 44-95
012900 013300 tileset_4bpp data/gfx/tiles_strip2.bin        ; 4bpp tiles, unreferenced
013300 013400 tilemap      data/maps/tilemap_strip3.bin     ; 32x4 tilemap, tile idx 44-A0
013400 014fe0 tileset_4bpp data/gfx/tiles_strip3.bin        ; 4bpp tiles, unreferenced; tail contains further tilemap-like words
014fe0 0155e0 tileset_2bpp data/gfx/font_tiles.bin          ; 2bpp font, 96 glyphs = ASCII $20-$7F (plane 1 empty, effectively 1bpp); only font in the ROM
0155e0 018000 filler       data/filler/fill_55_a.bin        ; fill 0x55
018000 01841a code         data/misc/sound_iface.bin        ; 65816 sound interface, bank $C1 (spc_init, spc_command, uploads); includes orphan_C183F1 dead code and a stale duplicate byte run at C18403-C18414 (see out/dream.asm)
01841a 01eac0 stale        data/stale/stale_dup_bg1_mode3.bin ; stale duplicate of 08041A-086AC0 (game_mode 3 BG1 4bpp tileset, minus its first 0x41A bytes)
01eac0 01efc0 stale        data/stale/stale_dup_bg1_tiles_mode2_tail.bin ; stale duplicate of 076E02-077302 (the last 1280 bytes / 40 tiles of bg1_tiles_mode2); exact byte-for-byte match, found by full-length substring search
01efc0 020000 filler       data/filler/fill_55_b.bin        ; fill 0x55
